description: A month of the Chinese calendar (农历 / 黄历), one entry per day: lunar date, day pillar, day officer and whether it is favorable, moon phase, plus the exact times of new and full moons, the start of each solar term (节气) and each new lunar month. Answers which days are favorable by day officer, when the next new or full moon is, when a solar term or lunar month begins, or when Lunar New Year falls. Uses the location the client shares when no city is given.

city.description: Optional. City name, e.g. 'Los Angeles' or 'Paris, France'. Omit to use the user's location.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Omit to use the user's location.

name: get_almanac_month
title: Chinese calendar for a month
